title: Ambedkar Nagar
player_goal: Rent a room on the hill; check signal first.
design_goal: Verticality (three terraces), a tiny tech-literacy joke (test the signal with Reels), the player's first own place; money dips near zero on purpose with the salary twelve days away.

cast.role: Three rooms; teaches the Reels signal test (reels_taught); points to Aunty after room3_checked
Chai ₹15 (food, −stress); the slope's save point (purchases autosave)

beats.what: Bus 335-E from the Whitefield street drops you at the slope. Manju: test the signal at each door — open Reels. Reels unlocks.

Three doors on three terraces: ground floor (0 bars — no network), maroon door (1 bar — buffers forever), green door on top (2 bars — buffers, then plays). Standing in a door zone sets the phone's bars; opening a clip checks the room.

Aunty at the top: ₹9,000 + ₹16,000 (two months at the old rate). Compare with the PG, argue one month's deposit (the ID card helps), never lowball. Deal ≈ ₹16,500–18,000 → flat_signed; the salary countdown starts (12 days).

The green door opens: your room. The godown box (table + chair) is already inside. Rafiq sells the cot (₹4,500 / ₹2,000 second-hand) and the induction (₹2,200); they appear in the room. Money near zero — deliberate.
Sleep in your own room: heals, the countdown ticks, Amma and Sameer text.
Reels at night: the first fever clip from North Bangalore, a breadcrumb — scroll past.

assets_needed: sheets: Manju, Owner Aunty, Mani, Rafiq, kid (done)
acceptance: the bus from the Whitefield street lands at the slope and ticks 'Reach Ambedkar Nagar'
the phone shows 0 / 1 / 2 bars at the three doors and Reels buffers accordingly; opening a clip at a door sets roomN_checked
Aunty's bill starts at ₹25,000 and lands near ₹17,000 with a compare on rent and two reasons on the deposit; the green door is locked until flat_signed
the flat holds the godown box from the start, the cot after bed_bought, the stove after stove_bought
sleeping on the cot heals, sets slept_in_flat and counts the salary down; day 0 credits ₹42,000 on the UPI ledger
the fever reel appears after flat_signed and sets reels_reel_fever_seen when watched
